newsitem.title: INDIA: India confirms Chidambaram is finance minister.
newsitem.headline: India confirms Chidambaram is finance minister.

text.p: P. Chidambaram has been named finance minister in Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's government, an official spokesman confirmed on Thursday.
Jaipal Reddy, who was sworn in earlier as a cabinet minister along with Chidambaram, has been given charge of the Information and Broadcasting Ministry, the spokesman said.
